design: A fixed gap of £1.1m with no borrowing and reserves at a floor. Every route to fill it (cut adult evening courses, spend savings, thin out the English and maths hours or cap the intake) crosses a red line the citizens will set. Built so each careful answer breaks at least one limit.
tests_hint: Limits: no adult evening course closes; savings stay above two months of running costs; no returning young person gets less than a set number of English and maths hours. Tests: all 300 offered a place this year; says who pays and how much; a named person to call for each young person.
angles: Spend the savings and cap the intake
